# captainscor.ch

> Personal portfolio of Daniel Schmier (captainscorch): Design Engineer specializing in full-stack development, product design, and modern web technologies.

Use the pages below for structured context about projects, articles, and contact paths.

Pages are not locale-prefixed — one URL serves English and German, switched in the browser. This file is a compact map for search and AI agents. The **agent operating manual** — how markdown exports work, which URLs to deep-link, and what must stay human-confirmed — lives at [/agents.md](https://captainscor.ch/agents.md).

## Site

- [Home](https://captainscor.ch/): Landing and overview.
- [About](https://captainscor.ch/about): About me / CV.
- [Portfolio](https://captainscor.ch/portfolio): Selected case studies and personal projects.
- [Blog](https://captainscor.ch/blog): Articles and insights on design, development and beyond.
- [Playground](https://captainscor.ch/playground): Experiments and interactive demos.
